lines.t: I was running through a wasteland heart
Chasing shadows in the dark
Every road just led to dust
Every high was never numb
Then you stepped into my night
Like a spark of living light
Spoke my name into the flame
And I've never been the same
I feel the rush of heaven breaking through my chest
Every chain is falling at the sound of your breath
You set my soul on fire, burning with a holy spark
You pulled me from the silence, lit up every fire
I, I wish you were my savior
You're the rhythm in my veins
Now I'm living wide awake
And I'll never be the same
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
I was drowning in the noise
Every lie I called my voice
But you cut through everything
Like a truth I couldn't fake
Now I'm breathing something real
Something death could never steal
Every heartbeat testifies
You're the reason I'm alive
Now I feel the rush of heaven
Breaking through my chest
Every chain is falling
At the sound of your breath
You set my soul on fire
Burning with a holy spark
You pulled me from the silence and lit up every fire
Yeshua, my Savior, You're the rhythm in my veins
Now I'm living wide awake and I'll never be the same
No more running, no more hiding
I'm Yours and I'm not fighting
And you rewrote my story, covered me in glory
From the ashes to the sky, you're the reason I can fly
Every second, every breath, you have conquered even death
You set my soul on fire, burning with a holy spark
Pull me from the silence and lit up every part
Wish you were my savior, you're the rhythm in my veins
Now I'm living wide awake and I'll never be the same
For me to light
Me to light
I come alive
I come alive
Thank you.
